items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: I remember one time, Marvin Johnson--do you know Marvin Johnson? ... Not far from where I had my business. So they came by just to say hello to me

ctx.x: You know, the musicians really sort of had a fraternal feeling, they were concerned about the families, individuals. I could understand that.
